# Humphrey

> Humphrey is a fifth-year pharmacy student at the University of Benin in Benin City, Nigeria, and co-founder and CEO of Naralt Technologies Limited, which makes job-tracking software for small service businesses.

## About

Humphrey studies pharmacy and builds software for small businesses in Nigeria. Naralt is an operations tool for dry cleaners, tailors, cobblers, phone repairers and car wash operators. He also built Memora, a personalised digital gift page with letters, photos, songs and voice messages, and early products including TEND.ng (a civic reporting platform) and PRAN (a site for a phage research network). He wrote a six-guide AI prompting bundle for non-technical founders and mentors younger pharmacy students.
